'''Ayuma''' is a continent located in the northern hemisphere. It is bordered by the [[Srandan Ocean]] to the north, the [[Rianian Ocean]] to the west, [[Hinsakian Ocean]] to the east, and the [[Vihsanna Ocean]] and [[Nasianian Sea]] to the south. The continent covers around {{convert|19,736,033|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 2nd largest continent in the world, with a total of about 1,020,200,000 as of 1765, making it also the 5th largest continent by population behind [[Acrola]], [[Mahea]], [[Massir]] and [[Quia]].
